reason: I assume these free-money sites are scams until proven otherwise, and a TikTok about a no-proof settlement is the oldest hook in the book. I'm not creating an account so I can chase ten-dollar payouts and still fill out the official form myself.
objection: You say the listings aren't verified and a paid model may come later — so I give you my info now for unverified claims, and then you start charging. What's the catch?
would_change_my_mind: If my bank or the official claims administrator pointed me here, I could check a settlement without an account, and it paid enough to be worth an evening — a couple hundred, not ten bucks.
